strengths: AMBIENT.adult pool (4 lines) directly fills the void I flagged in round 3 — 'The ordinary week turns out to be where a life is actually lived.' is exactly the cozy-meditative register the middle decades needed, and it reads as observation rather than filler

Fall/rise narration ('the family climbed / slipped this generation') lands as gentle narrative, not a score-screen alert — it surfaces at the moment that caused it, which is emotionally resonant without breaking the calm

Competing-goods adult cards (x_honest_or_kind, x_loyalty_truth, x_dream_or_duty) are the best content in the game: no right answer, both roads are forms of love, and the elder callback cb_the_cost that reads them back years later is genuinely moving

Reputation rebalance (0.12 fade per generation, scholarly/kind houses earning seat rises) makes the dynasty layer feel like a slow, earned story rather than a grind — rising on kindness is the cozy design ideal

Transcripts confirm the adult stretch now feels varied and unhurried across all five dynasties — Calla Mercer and Soren Marchetti lives in particular show a good density of thoughtful moments without repetition
Audio stays at 0.42 max volume, opt-in, fading gracefully — the whole soundscape philosophy is right: music sits under the reading, not over it
The heirloom inheritance guard (marking inherited memories so reputation can't be re-scored passively) quietly prevents dynasty collapse to a monoculture — elegant and invisible to the player

improvements.what: Add 2-3 more adult ambient lines that are specific to having dependents or a household — something like 'The house has its own sounds now, and {n} has learned all of them.'
improvements.why: The 4 existing adult lines are season/time-flavored but none reference the domestic intimacy most adult lives have by then; a cozy game's middle years feel warmest when they name the texture of ordinary home life

improvements.what: The 'loss' CSS class on the seat-slip narration — verify it doesn't render in a harsh red or warning colour; it should be a muted, elegiac tone, not a penalty colour
improvements.why: The prose is gentle but if the colour treatment is red/alarm it undercuts the non-punishing intent; cozy games treat decline as bittersweet, not failure

improvements.what: Add one adult-specific ambient line for lives in financial difficulty (means < 35) — something like 'The end of the month keeps arriving before the money does.' is already in the log as a prose observation (seen in Marguerite's life); surfacing that register as an ambient whisper too would complete the loop
improvements.why: The game handles modest circumstances with dignity in the log but the ambient whispers are all contentedly neutral; a gentle note of ordinary-scarcity would deepen the cozy range without adding stress

verdict: Round 4 landed the one fix that genuinely mattered — the adult ambient pool now makes the long middle decades feel inhabited — and the competing-goods cards plus the gentle dynasty narration together bring this firmly above the bar for meditative, literary play.
